initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Transform reference 1 (the approved QQ2008 idle design) into a matching QR CODE LOGIN screen for the same H1 application. Reference 2 is the approved H1 QQ penguin artwork: keep the recognizable black penguin, red scarf, white belly, yellow beak/feet, but remove its square app-icon tile for the main mascot. This is a design preview with a synthetic QR placeholder, not a live login code.

Deliver one finished 16:9 landscape design, ideally 1600x900, straight-on edge-to-edge application UI, no device mockup, no desktop outside the app, no annotations, no collage. It must clearly belong to the exact same classic QQ 2008 blue skin: glossy cyan/sky-blue chrome, cloud wisps, faint curved waves and a pale globe in a lower corner, white glints, fine blue/silver beveled rim, restrained early-2000s skeuomorphic details. Nearly square corners with only the original modest window radius. Avoid contemporary rounded cards, mobile-app layout, purple, dark theme, huge typography or promotional posters. Think in native 480x272 coordinates enlarged for review; essential Chinese text should correspond to crisp small native 12px labels, with restrained static QQ branding.

Keep only the slim shared top title band: classic small penguin and italic 'QQ 2008' branding at left, one small close/back control at right. Remove the friend list, personal avatar/name, green logged-in badge, roster tabs, chat history, message toolbar, input box and send button: this is BEFORE login, not the main messenger window.

Body layout: airy balanced two-column composition on one continuous very pale ice-blue/white field, with no heavy dividing line. On the left, a friendly medium-sized full-body QQ penguin mascot centered around logical x=110,y=150, about 100 logical pixels tall. Match the idle design's softly shaded classic mascot, small oval shadow and a couple of sparse pale-blue speech/sparkle motifs. Keep the empty space calm and intentional. The curved background waves and subtle globe should connect visually with the existing idle page; no text around the mascot, no giant app-logo tile, no extra devices or phones.

On the right, a single prominent perfectly square white QR panel, with a delicate blue-gray beveled border and subtle shadow. Center its QR around logical x=316,y=145. A real implementation needs an unobstructed square that can hold a 135x135 QR and up to 160x160 QR plus a clean white quiet zone within the H1 480x272 screen. Therefore keep the QR card approximately 180 logical pixels square and preserve a generous white border. Use a plausible black-and-white synthetic QR pattern with three normal finder squares as a visual placeholder only. No logo over its modules, no rounded dots, no gradients inside the code, no decorative corner brackets intruding into it, no overlapping title or artwork.

Exact minimal Chinese labels: above the QR panel, '手机 QQ 扫码'. Below the panel, a quiet centered status '等待扫码'. A small classic blue refresh-arrow icon sits to the right of the status as a discreet real control; avoid a big modern CTA. These two short labels and the top 'QQ 2008' are the ONLY text on screen. The status area should have enough room to later switch to '请在手机确认' without disturbing the code. Do not add explanatory paragraphs, shortcuts, debug/USB/ESP/network/CPU/native text, passwords/account fields, remember-login checkboxes, QR expiration countdowns, software version footers, slogans, marketing claims, scan tutorials or redundant 'welcome/login' headings.

Preserve the approved design's proportions, bevels, mascot quality, sky-blue gloss and quiet details. The result should be a practical elegant login companion to the approved idle state, easy to reproduce using fixed background artwork plus a dynamic real QR and dynamic small text.

refinement.prompt:
Edit ONLY the QR-side sizing and vertical spacing of this QQ2008 login design; preserve its entire 16:9 canvas, blue skin, title bar, background artwork, globe/waves, left penguin and speech/sparkle decorations. The current white QR panel is too small relative to the screen. This design will be implemented at logical 480x272, so it MUST physically fit a real up-to-160x160 logical-pixel QR plus quiet white margins. Enlarge the square white QR card to approximately 176x176 logical pixels: about 65% of the whole image height, and about 36.7% of its whole width. Keep the card centered near logical x=316, y=144; its rectangle should approximately span logical x=228..404 and y=56..232. At a 1672x941 output, that means roughly 613x609 physical pixels. Enlarge the black-and-white synthetic QR placeholder inside proportionally, retaining a clear white quiet zone, square hard black modules and the existing blue-gray beveled border/shadow. This is an illustrative code only, not a real login token.

Place the exact heading '手机 QQ 扫码' ABOVE the enlarged panel around logical y=36, with clear separation from both the top bar and the panel. Keep heading size modest, equivalent to 12px logical text. Place exact status '等待扫码' BELOW the enlarged panel around logical y=243, and a small blue refresh icon just to the right; do not let either touch the code's white quiet zone or the bottom window border. The enlarged panel should remain completely within the main window. Keep the left penguin exactly as it is, including its size and position; no extra text or controls. Do not change or add any other wording. Final output one 16:9 screen, no labels or explanatory callouts.
